_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/s15-resume-fails-closed.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-20 (unattended run 5).

features.description: A resume whose pending call names a tool absent from the runtime executes nothing and does not write the person's answer as the tool result.
That call's tool result is the fixed unavailable record, on its own tool_call_id.
Deny and free text on a missing tool also execute nothing and also get the fixed unavailable record, never the answer.
A pending call whose tool is present but no longer requires_confirmation does not execute and gets the fixed approval_no_longer_applies record.
A pending call that was not an approval question, whose tool is present and ungated, resolves byte-identically to today.
Single-question approve, deny and free-text behaviour on a present gated tool is byte-identical to today.
S14 still holds: a Deny withholds every Approve in the group, and a group mixing a missing tool with a gated one executes nothing.
The streaming resume behaves identically and emits the same ToolEnded events for the not-executed calls.
It holds through the public resume_run path on a record-backed session whose linked agent lost the tool between pause and resume.
No tool message written by the not-executed rows equals or contains the person's answer string.
With no asked-questions record available, the missing-tool and gated rows still hold and the ordinary row is unchanged.
_invoke, _resolve_confirmation, _confirmation_question and _has_denial are byte-identical to their reviewed form, and upstream's TestAgentConfirmation is unmodified and green.
